description: Submit an inference request to the queue and return immediately (async — does NOT wait for completion). Returns { request_id, response_url, status_url, cancel_url, queue_position }. Consumes fal credits when the model runs. fal.ai queue: POST {queue}/{model_id} with body = the model input.

input.description: The model's input object — arbitrary params for that model, e.g. { "prompt": "a cat" }. Use falai_get_model_schema to learn the fields.

model_id.description: The fal.ai model id, used raw as a path segment, e.g. 'fal-ai/flux/schnell'.

name: falai_submit_request
title: Submit request
